{"script":"set -e
# Resolve and confirm /working
if [ -e /working ] && [ -r /working ]; then
  realpath /working > target_path.txt
else
  realpath -m /working > target_path.txt
fi
TARGET=$(cat target_path.txt)
# Recursive listing with entry type
if [ -e "$TARGET" ]; then
  find "$TARGET" -printf '%y %p\n' > recursive_listing.txt 2>/dev/null || true
else
  : > recursive_listing.txt
fi
# Extract basenames exactly 'workspace' from recursive_listing.txt
awk '{ t=substr($0,1,1); path=substr($0,3); n=split(path,a,"/"); if(a[n]=="workspace") print t " " path }' recursive_listing.txt | sort -u > candidates.txt
# Create verification_summary.json (one entry per candidate)
python3 - <<'PY' > verification_summary.json
import json
c=[]
try:
    tp=open('target_path.txt').read().strip()
except:
    tp=''
for line in open('candidates.txt'):
    line=line.rstrip('\n')
    if not line: continue
    t=line[0]
    path=line[2:]
    c.append({'path':path,'type':t})
obj={'target_path':tp,'candidates':c}
print(json.dumps(obj))
PY
# Final check: is there a regular file named 'workspace' under /working?
if [ -e "$TARGET" ]; then
  if find "$TARGET" -type f -name workspace -print -quit >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo yes
  else
    echo no
  fi
else
  echo no
fi
"}
